items.title: WhatsApp Malware 'Maverick' Hijacks Browser Sessions to Target Brazil's Biggest Banks
items.description: Threat hunters have uncovered similarities between a banking malware called Coyote and a newly disclosed malicious program dubbed Maverick that has been propagated via WhatsApp. According to a report from CyberProof, both malware strains are written in .NET, target Brazilian users and banks, and feature identical functionality to decrypt, targeting banking URLs and monitor banking applications.
